response.message: Astra: You announced a deletion, but the revelation remains; replacing “这片花瓣” with itself also changes nothing. Let’s set the unresolved workplace detail aside for now. Stay with her looking at the chrysanthemum: which detail deserves closer attention, and what can she actually perceive rather than conclude? Revise only that moment, then compare the actual sentences—not your intentions—to see whether the reader’s view has changed. A small, visible change is enough.
response.rationale: Interrupts cosmetic rewriting and unsupported revision claims, shifting attention within the same scene toward perceptible detail and an actual textual comparison.
